description: List the wikis of a project you can access (projectID, or project by name or task prefix) as a flat tree (id, name, parentWikiID, sortOrder, childCount, dateModified; max 500), optionally filtered by name or parent. Only wikis your Laviya permissions let you see are listed. Read-only. Use the id with laviya_get_wiki, laviya_update_wiki or as parentWikiID of laviya_create_wiki.

parentWikiID.description: 0 lists only the top-level wikis of the project, a wiki id only its direct sub wikis. Default: all wikis.

project.description: Project name, part of it, or task prefix (e.g. LVY) instead of projectID. It must match exactly one of your projects.

projectID.description: Laviya project (see laviya_list_projects). Pass projectID or project.

name: laviya_list_wikis
title: List Wikis
